gloss: Hakone Ekiden (New Year university relay race)

definitions.gloss: Hakone Ekiden, the New Year university relay race
definitions.explanation: A two-day university relay road race held on January 2 and 3, in which teams of ten runners race from central Tokyo to Lake Ashi in Hakone and back, about 217 kilometers in all. Broadcast live for hours, it is a fixture of the New Year holidays.

examples.english: A runner who stars on the Hakone Ekiden's uphill mountain leg is called a "god of the mountain."

notes:
First held in 1920. The teams come mainly from universities in the Kantō region.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{往路|おうろ}→往路：18214_ouro⟧ / ⟦{復路|ふくろ}→復路：20538_fukuro⟧: the outbound race (January 2) and the return race (January 3)
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧: the star runner of the fifth, uphill leg
- たすき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つなぐ: to pass on the relay sash — also used figuratively for carrying on someone's work

CULTURAL NOTE:
Watching the race on TV between New Year meals is a family ritual for many households, and a strong Hakone showing raises a university's profile with prospective students.
